settings.title: SUBSCRIBE + SAVE!
settings.text:
We're making it easier than ever to start your very own collection of General Conference books!

Don't worry about remembering to come back twice a year to order your next book.

By subscribing, you will be automatically charged for the next book when it is ready to ship, approximately 8 weeks after General Conference at a 20% discount!
